name: Gahz'rilla
summary: Wizzle Brassbolts asks you to bring Gahz'rilla's Electrified Scale to him in the Shimmering Flats. The scale is what he seeks from Gahz'rilla.

sections.title: Wizzle's Request
sections.body: In the Shimmering Flats, Wizzle Brassbolts is waiting for Gahz'rilla's Electrified Scale. You are asked to bring the scale to him, and his request rests on what you can bring back from Gahz'rilla.

faq.q: What does Wizzle want from Gahz'rilla?
faq.answer: Wizzle Brassbolts wants Gahz'rilla's Electrified Scale brought to him in the Shimmering Flats.

faq.q: Who is asking for the scale?
faq.answer: Wizzle Brassbolts asks you to bring him Gahz'rilla's Electrified Scale.

faq.q: Where do I bring the scale?
faq.answer: Bring Gahz'rilla's Electrified Scale to Wizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.
